description:
We work with many different clients in a CFO capacity. Our staff has great knowledge when it comes to excel but often, we need to translate this into PowerQuery for repeatable tasks.

An example problem we're currently facing;
- We get data exported from an ERP system (no direct link available)
- This is transaction data in rows but there are multiple line items for each transaction
- The transaction # and a few other columns are only on the first row and do not repeat
- Let's say 5 rows down, a new value for transaction # (or other column) is noted, this means there's a new transaction for which the rows will need to repeat.

In Excel, we use the current formula;
- We use the "created date" since that is unique to each row (sometimes there is no transaction #)
- We use an IF statement to compare the current row's created date/time to the previous row, 
= If it's the same, then copy the value above in the current row;
= If it's different, leave it blank (for the occasions when there is no transaction number above to copy)

This formula is put into every blank cell for certain columns.

See the attached file for an example. Original data is the data we get, the second tab has the formulas added in Blue.

We do a few tasks like this a month, you would need to be able to connect with us on Zoom or Teams to walk through the solution.

Please provide an explanation of how you would do this in Power Query, we are not interested in "free" work, but please show us you know how to solve this problem in your reply. You don't have to include the actual code for PQ.

Note; Although you can use fill-in power query for a few of the columns (like transaction created date), you cannot use it for the transaction number since some transactions do not have a transaction number. This is the part I would need help with. See row 27 on the sample file as a transaction without a transaction #. If you used fill function, it would copy trx# 20 onto this different transaction that originally did not have a trx #.
title: PowerQuery Formulas - Convert excel formulas to PowerQuery

description:
# What is DataWars #
DataWars is a Data Science education platform that focuses on explaining concepts throughout interactive projects.

# Project definition #
Your job will be to create a project for our platform on the topic: Filtering and Sorting Pandas DataFrames. You’ll be using a Dataset of FIFA 22 Players (see attached).
You’ll have to create different interactive activities for our students that validate that they know the concepts of filtering and conditional selection with Pandas.

Your project should be structured in the following sections:
1) A quick overview of the dataset, including a few visualizations of the columns to understand the data.
2) Basic selection using simple comparison operators (greater than, smaller than, equals, etc).
3) Selection combining boolean operators AND (&), OR (|), NOT (~). `df.loc[(df["COLUMN 1"] == 150) & (df["COLUMN 2"] == "Red)]`
4) Selection of values that are duplicate and contain null values.

We want you to be creative with the activities that you include, in order to make it engaging for our students. Your project should include AT LEAST 15 activities/questions (of which, at least 10 should be Jupyter/interactive activities).

All your activities should have thoughtful solutions explaining the process to solve them, as well as alternatives if possible.

# Important Considerations #
We are very strict with the format of our projects, so BEFORE YOU ACCEPT this offer, we ask you to do the following two things:

## a) Complete the projects we already have posted ##
Use the invite code `upwork` to sign up for a free account at https://beta.datawars.io. Complete the project titled “Practicing filtering sorting with Pokemon” (https://beta.datawars.io/module/54b07e96-f0da-4b5d-ba40-c87475e42b8e).

## b) Review the handbook for Project Creators ##
Our projects are created with a special syntax combining Markdown and special HTML tags. Please review it carefully to make sure you understand the format and you agree to create the project following it.

https://github.com/datawars-io-content/content-creator-handbook

# Are you ready to accept this job? #
You’ll be creating the project in our Github account, so please send us your Github username so we can give you access to your project's repo.

# What's next? #
If you enjoy creating these type of practical projects, you can become a content creator at DataWars. We have hundreds of cool project ideas for our students, and we'd love to have you onboard in the team working with us. Consider this project as a check to see how well we work together.
title: Write a Data Science practical project for my students using Python/Pandas

description: We have N rooms, all running on a single circuit that has a circuit breaker that trips at 2000W.  Each room has a heater that can run at 2000W max.  There are N people who enter and leave the rooms randomly.  When someone enters one of the rooms, that room needs to be heated to exactly 30C following some heating curve (typically, as fast as possible), at which point the heater will need to maintain the 30C temperature.  When the person leaves their room, the heater will shut off, however that person cannot leave the room until the room has reached 30C for some minutes.  Each room can only be occupied by one person so it is possible that all the heaters will run at the same time.The goal is to heat the occupied rooms as quickly as possible without tripping the circuit breaker.  For example, assuming that no other rooms are occupied when person A enters room 1, the heater in room 1 can run at 2000W until it reaches 30C.  However, if person B enters room 2 while room 1 is heating up, since running the heaters at max power in both room 1 and room 2 would cause the circuit breaker to trip, the controller would need to reduce the heating power of room 1 so that room 2 could also be heated, and so on.  Similarly, once someone leaves a room, the power to the other rooms can be increased accordingly.Rooms that have reached 30C will have priority in power usage in order to maintain their temperature, based on a first-come, first-served basis.  So, if a room reaches 30C, and it requires 1500W to maintain the room’s temperature, then only 500W will be available to heat the remaining rooms.   In reality, it is possible (and likely) that there will be minimal heat loss so maintaining 30C will not require much power but it when it does need to turn on the heater to maintain the temp, that room will have priority.  Although the description is a bit wordy, this is a straightforward multi-input/output control problem.  We need an algorithm to do the above control.We currently do not have power-temp speed data for the rooms but we will be able to get that data once the heaters are installed.  As such, we will also need a controller tuning algorithm based on the power-temp characteristics of the rooms (e.g. an algorithm/method to find the PID values based on empirical data).Deliverables:1.	Proposed solution (paper/text format)2.	Control algorithm (paper/text format)3.	Controller tuning algorithm (paper/text format)4.	Control and tuning algorithms (Matlab/excel format)5.	Control and tuning algorithms (C/C++ format)Budget: $150Posted On: February 14, 2024 04:19 UTCCategory: Electrical EngineeringSkills:Load Calculation,     Power Distribution,     MATLAB,     C,     Mathematics,     Algorithm Development,     Machine Learning,     Electrical Engineering,     C++Skills:        Load Calculation,                     Power Distribution,                     MATLAB,                     C,                     Mathematics,                     Algorithm Development,                     Machine Learning,                     Electrical Engineering,                     C++Country: Japanclick to apply
title: Multi-heater Control Algorithm

description:
We are an agency that offers CRO/UX audit reports focused on user experience and conversion rate optimization by utilizing user testing. 

What this means is we send real people to our customers websites, have them speak out loud while recording their screen as they try to understand and use the site. Then we deliver these videos to our customers to help them pin point where things are confusing or frustrating. 

We offer a done for your service where we watch the videos for the customer and provide expert insights into what we found. 

We need a few CRO/UX experts to help us execute on our report overflow. We are looking for a long-term arrangement. Note: We also have a high-touch service with additional services so there are more opportunities than what is listed in this job ad. 

How it works is we run a user test on the customer's site. 

1. The Research team will 
- watch the videos
- summarize what happened
- make note of key moments

2. Then you come in! You take this information, analyze it, review the website yourself, and see if you find anything missed based on your experience/expertise on that specific part of the website we are testing. 

3. You organize the actionables 
- prioritize the findings based on effort to implement, impact, and severity. 
- tagging each actionable as: quick win, small project, or save for redesign. 
- note which changes should just be implemented and which ones should be a/b tested. 

4. Write the report by providing guidance for executing on said actionable so that it is "development ready". What this means is that the customer can pass your instructions directly to a developer and they can execute without further guidance.  
- This could be in the form of examples, quick mock-up, helping to reframe copy, etc. 

The idea is that the customer gets a very actionable, easy to understand report, that is focused on the 80/20 changes they need to implement and which ones to save for a redesign or larger project. 

5. Create a short loom video going over your findings. 

6. Suggest upsells for the specific customer based on what you see on the site, issues that were raised, etc. 

We are also open to feedback to making the reports better and also the process! 

------------------
Experience Wanted: 
- a/b testing experience or UX research experience
- conversion rate optimization 
- experience with analytics and deriving insights from them.
- great at written and spoken communication
- experience managing clients a plus!

I have a few screener questions including a request for a 1 min loom video, it saves me time from getting on calls and allows me to assess who to move forward with or not more efficiently. I understand if it's not the vibe for you. However, it's my secret sauce for finding the perfect fit. :)
title: UX/CRO expert needed to help agency overflow with reports

description: The simulations in the paper "Microgrid Fault Detection, Classification, and Location Based on the Boosting Ensemble Method" will be conducted using MATLAB  Simulink software. We are in the process of mapping out memory foam pillow and/or pillowcases that solve a problem that we have identified in the market. - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects at once
- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with the company founder

This is a contract-based position, with the opportunity for a long-term partnership as the company grows. If you are a creative and motivated industrial designer with a passion for home goods, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

description:
We are a web design & digital marketing agency looking to add an experienced Oxygen developer to our team!

We deliver high-quality websites that our clients use to generate more business online!

We are looking for someone who has experience with Oxygen and can help with developing websites for our clients. You will need to have experience with Oxygen Builder to be accepted to this job.

Why Oxygen Builder? We are obsessed with delivering high-quality websites. We care about custom design-work, high-performance, and delivering the highest quality websites to our clients.

We are looking to add someone to our team, your first task will be to build out a website, you will have full control of the project and development. If everything goes well, we will continue to give you projects to help deliver websites to our clients. 

Here is what is important to us:

- Oxygen Builder & WordPress experience.
- Ability to develop websites according to Figma design OR without a Figma design. Some clients pay for Figma design, others don’t, so you need to be able to deliver high-quality websites with or without a UI design available.
- Proper HTML semantic tags to be used throughout the design. 
- Using BEM to organize CSS classes. 
- Experience with HTML and CSS.
- JavaScript, PHP, and/or MySQL is a plus!
- Some experience with WooCommerce.
- Care about website performance, Google PageSpeed Insights must pass Core Web Vitals.
- Ability to work with our Project Management software, basically just update tasks as completed as you are finishing work.

We also have an Oxygen Framework (CSS Custom Properties) that we use for colors, spacing, etc. If you are familiar with CSS, this shouldn’t be tough to learn, and makes your websites consistent and easier once your custom properties are setup. 

Here is some information about the first project you would take on:
Develop a clean and high-performance website for a client, this first project will not include a Figma design, so you will be given instructions on what the client is looking for, then you are free to design the website using the project specifications paired with your skills and experience. 

This first project is a client who has only a few products, the pages needed are:
- Home
- Products
- About
- Contact
- Legal Pages

On this project, the client would like some animation/video/motion in the Hero. For example, they are a survival company, and would like a “survival” feel in the hero image. Maybe that means showing rain, snow, slider with weather, etc. 

You will have access to Motion.Page, if you would like to add animations that way, but not necessarily required on this project. 

We are looking for someone we can work with long-term. If you do a great job, we would love to assign you to projects regularly. Our only requirements are to use Oxygen Builder and to be passionate about delivering great designs and high-performance websites. 

Remember, we need you to be able to design amazing sites with or without a UI design. Some situations you will have a UI design, others you won’t, so you need to be able to deliver either way. 

If you can deliver high quality designs and high performance websites with Oxygen Builder, we would love to work with you and look forward to meeting with you!
title: Oxygen Developer to Join Our Team!

description:
We are looking for assistance in developing a search algorithm.  We understand that achieving our goals will take a developer with a lot of creativity and abilities to think of things in new, different ways.  This task will require real expertise.

Our desire is to make life easier for academics and other researchers by creating an online ecosystem offering access to the most important people, research, institutions, funding, etc. for very narrow, specialized technological areas.  In order to accomplish this goal, we need an automated search algorithm to help populate our content management system with relevant data before we invite participants to join the online community.

Our search algorithm development needs are:
1.	An extremely simple user interface allowing a very simple query about one focused technological niche area (such as “methane removal from ambient air” or “lithium ion battery recycling”)
a.	The development goal is to have one search algorithm that is flexible enough to accept any short query term
2.	The algorithm will, in response to the user query:
a.	Scrape the Internet in order to find ~200 known information points (such as contact details, articles written, patents filed, etc.), organized by about eight categories
i.	We expect this scraping probably will utilize a combination of (1) iterative uses of AI sources and (2) bots to scrape specific information sources and will use a combination of paid and unpaid sources.  We are open, though, to any way of accomplishing our goal.
3.	Requirements document/process
a.	We have tried developing the search algorithm using only AI sources, but the hallucination effects of the AI sources meant that the required information quality could not be found.  So, we are now looking for your help.
4.	Notes:
a.	Query speed will not essential—it is not a problem if the search takes minutes (or even a small number of hours).  Similarly, in paying for the appropriate AI sources, it will be acceptable for a search to cost several dollars or more.  However, information quality will be essential—we don’t mind waiting a bit and paying a bit for quality results, but we must have quality results.
b.	Before you make a proposal (but after the initial inquiries), we will provide you with an outline that shows the currently required information points and that has a listing of relevant specific information sources and potential AI sources.  That should be a good starting point for you to make a proposal.
title: Search algorithm development

Terra Global uses our proprietary TerraChange model to spatially predict the land-use changes that are used in quantifying future emissions and removals from deforestation, degradation, reforestation, and enhancement under market standards.  

Deliverable 1a
Rewrite TerraChange Matlab code into a recent version of Python to be run on local Terra Global computers. There are 1,170 lines of code.  The new code should include all the features and functionality existing in the current code and add a simple user interface to allow the user to enter a defined a set of input/output file names (and paths) and parameters needed to run the model. 

Deliverable 1b
Once the TerraChange code is running in Python and tested after Deliverable 1a, the following enhancements will be implemented.  This will require some additional scoping for each new feature which can be better done, once the first deliverable is underway completed.  
The following new functionality will be developed under Deliverable 1b:
1.	Enhanced Output Reporting
a.	user friendly reports from output (besides just the excel file with transitions and maps)
b.	ability for the user to provide shapefiles of small areas within the large one and produce area specific transitions and maps 
2.	Back Testing Feature
a.	Add a back testing feature to measure the accuracy of land use change predictions using historical data
3.	Non-static Spatial Input File
a.	Add functionality to use, where relevant a spatial drivers file that may change over time during the prediction period.

See detailed scope of work, and submission information required in the attached file.
title: Rewrite of Geospatial Land-use Change Model from MATLAB to Python and Support New Features

description:
Purpose;  
A generally repurposable Transformer model, used to create embedding of rich text data such as reviews, biographies and short form content of up to 2gb of training data.  
 
There are three components to the model:

1/ Clustering multiple text features into discrete groups 
2/ Ability for the model to generate similarity cosine scores for each cluster with a input text (i.e search query) 
3/ Infrastructure development to support deployment, scheduling and running of the model if GPUs are required to allow for scalability 

Scalability and speed are important as we intend to use the model for real-time applications as a result the model needs to run on GPUs and can easily be increased if there is a need for larger training sets. 

You would be required to write the code, deploy the code on infrastructure that can be run GPUs (we don’t have a preference for the specific cloud service to utilise, recommendations are welcome)

Example use cases: 

For example we want to cluster all the member of linkedin using their bio, job experience and recommendations into groups of similar members. 

When we add an input of “Professions who are good at dancing and banking” the model can product a ranking of all the clusters ranked by the cosine distance 


Requirements  

Transformer model should have a maximum latency of 5 seconds for 20mb of input data.   
Python as the primary language (either tensorflow or Pytorch)
The model should  be capable of converting reviews, bios, and other text into cosine similar scores 
The model should be able to handle input text of varying lengths and format without a maximum limit on the length. 
The model should be able to produce an embedding for each input text that captures the meaning of the text.
The model should be able to handle large amounts of data and easily scalable with additional GPUs using a cloud service 
The model should be able to produce an embedding with at least 300 dimensions for each input text that captures the meaning of the text.
The model should be able to handle a minimum of 100,000 input text and should be able to scale to handle at least 1,000,000 input text.
The model should have a minimum accuracy of 90% on a held-out test set of data.
The model should be able to handle at least 5 different languages.
The model should be able to be trained on a minimum of 50,000 text inputs and fine-tuned on at least 5,000 text inputs.
The model should have the ability to update embeddings as more data is fed into the model, with at least once a day.
title: Machine learning engineer for NLP embedding models

description:
The Weekend Fitness Club (WFC) needs software for managing bookings made by the customers. The club offers
different group fitness lessons on both Saturday and Sunday. The types of fitness lessons could be SPIN, YOGA,
BODYSCULPT, ZUMBA, etc. Each lesson can accommodate 5 customers at most. For either day (Saturday or
Sunday), there are 2 fitness lessons per day. The lesson prices are different for different types of fitness activities.
However, the same type of lessons will have the same price no matter what time they are run.
A customer who wants to book a lesson has two choices to view the timetable. The first choice is to view by day.
For example, a customer has chosen Saturday, then all the lessons on all the Saturdays will be displayed. The
second choice is to view by the fitness type. For example, a customer has chosen YOGA, then all the YOGA
lessons on all the days in the timetable will be displayed. The customer will then book a lesson according to the
timetable s/he has viewed. Customers are allowed to change a booking, provided there are still spaces available
for the newly selected lesson. A customer can book as many lessons as they want. Customers are also allowed to
cancel a booking before the booked lesson was attended.
After each group fitness lesson, customers can write a review of the lesson they have attended and provide a
numerical rating ranging from 1 to 5 (1: Very dissatisfied, 2: Dissatisfied, 3: Ok, 4: Satisfied, 5: Very Satisfied).
The review and rating information will be recorded in the system. After four weeks (four weekends), the software
system must print:
• a report containing the number of customers per lesson on each day, along with the average rating of each
lesson;
• a report containing the type of fitness lessons which has generated the highest income, counting all the
same type of lessons together.
In your final deliverable, you need to design at least 8 weekends of timetable (i.e., 32 lessons) by yourself and
cover at least 4 different types of fitness lessons. All the customers may be assumed to be pre-registered or you
can provide a function to add customers to the system.
Note: you do not need any kind of external database for this program. The final program should be self-contained.
The reports can be printed to System.out, or output to a suitable GUI interface. You also do not need any kind of
security protocol.


Tasks List:
1. Create a class diagram, highlighting the main Java classes in the system and their associations. Include the
attributes and key methods.
2. Implement the system, using Junit tests to confirm the functionality.
3. Write a report explaining the code.
title: Expert Java Developer

How hard will it be to create a sales role play with GPT-3

The difficulty of creating a sales role play with GPT-3 will depend on several factors, such as your technical expertise, the complexity of the role play scenario, and the level of customization required.

If you have experience with natural language processing, machine learning, and software development, you may find it relatively straightforward to create a simple sales role play using GPT-3. However, creating a more sophisticated role play that includes multiple scenarios, decision tree logic, and interactive elements may require a more advanced skill set and a significant investment of time and resources.

Here are some of the main steps involved in creating a sales role play with GPT-3:

Preparation: Gather data and train the GPT-3 model on sales language, customer engagement strategies, and product knowledge.

UI Design: Design the user interface that will enable the role play scenario and provide a conversational interface between the customer and the AI model.

Integration: Integrate the GPT-3 model and the user interface to create a functioning simulation of a sales conversation.

Testing: Test the role play to identify any bugs or areas for improvement, and make any necessary changes.

Deployment: Deploy the role play for use by sales teams, either as a standalone application or as part of a larger training program.

In conclusion, the difficulty of creating a sales role play with GPT-3 will depend on your technical expertise and the complexity of the role play scenario, but it can be a challenging and time-consuming process. It may be helpful to seek the assistance of a professional developer or team if you're looking to create a more complex or sophisticated role play.

description: Request for QuotePLC program for Wind Turbine Diversion Load ControllerBy Bruce Hatchett   Feb 12, 2024Summary:   The purpose of the PLC is to shut off (disable) four MorningStar TS-60 diversion load controllers so that the solar can charge the batteries up to the absorb voltage.   After the absorb cycle is complete, the TS-60 should limit the charging to the float set point.Equipment:Automation Direct Click PLC, model with four Modbus serial ports, two analog inputs, at least two digital inputs and at least 16 digital outputs.   The PLC will be 24 vdc powered.Modbus serial ports to disable and enable four Morningstar TS-60 diversion load controllers  (See attached email and manuals)Analog input 1: 42 to 60 VDCAnalog input 2:  DC current 0 to 300 amps at 48 VDC.Digital input 1: ON/OFF   (off=all TS-60 enabled)Digital input 2: Reset buttonDigital output 1: Status TS-60 1Digital output 2: Status TS-60 2Digital output 3: Status TS-60 3Digital output 4: Status TS-60 4Digital output 5: Indicator light error 1 and beeperDigital output 6:  Indicator light error 2Digital output 7:  Indicator light error 3Digital output ... :  Indicator light error …Digital output 16:  Indicator light error 12Logic:1)	If it has been more than 12 hours since batteries were at 57.6 volts, disable TS-60 (disabled allows wind and solar to start to charge batteries up to 57.6)2)	If batteries greater than 57.5 volts for 2 hours enable TS-60s (prevents overcharging due to too much time.)3)	If batteries are greater than 57.7 vdc enable TS-60s (This will interrupt the 2-hour timer in logic line two.   Only the wind will do this.  Solar will be steady at 57.6.   If wind energy is greater than AC loads during the solar absorb cycle, the excess wind energy will increase battery volts above 57.6 and overcharge the battery.   This logic prevents overcharging due to too much voltage.)4)	Detect the status of each TS-60  either enabled or disabled:   If enabled and if the battery voltage = 54.4 then TS-60 should be diverting current to the dump load resistors.5)	Detect errors:  1=more than 2 hours in absorb cycle,  2=more than 57.7 volts, 3=no current on DC Buss while trying to limit voltage,  4=current on DC buss when not trying to limit voltage.  5=No DC volts.  6=no current for greater than 3 days, 7=battery greater than 57.7 more than 3 times in a 24 hour period,  8=battery did not complete 2 hour absorb cycle two days in a row, 9=ON/OFF switch ON for more than 2 days, and more.6)	ON/OFF switch: OFF stops the PLC from disabling the TS-60s (always enabled).   The batteries will never be fully charged if the switch is left OFF.  Disabling the TS-60 allows for full charging.7)	Reset button:  This button silences the alarm and resets it so that it is ready to respond to the next alarm condition.    The reset button clears the display of errors.   Errors like battery greater than 57.7 and no DC Volts will reappear almost instantly so those errors need to be exempt from sounding the alarm for about an hour.Hourly Range: $35.00-$45.00Posted On: February 13, 2024 08:35 UTCCategory: Electrical EngineeringSkills:PLC If you are looking for a family feel environment, where you can make life long friends and genuinely enjoy coming to work then this is the place for you!

We have a try-on model that uses Mediapipe, yolo v7 and a generative model. 

We are using YOLOv7 to calculate the three-dimensional pose points of a person. When the image is passed to Yolo for inference, the non-max suppression creates a bottleneck in the whole inference pipeline.

The Mediapipe runs on the CPU while the rest of the model inference is done on the GPU. We have deployed the model for live inference in Flask, but we are only getting up to 7-8 FPS on the local RTX 3090.

We are looking for an individual who can look at the code and improve its performance. Please reach out if you are experienced with this. Thanks!
title: Improve the performance (FPS) of a Machine Learning Model with Flask backend

Address input box. Then, upon hitting "Fetch Property Info!" button, the next page/script retrieves property/owner data from at least 4 of the following 6 domains, assuming one or two may end up being too hard to crawl.

5. Does the same on https://clustrmaps.com/  (Example https://clustrmaps.com/a/18bv2s/)

These domains above are listed in order of importance. But, for example, if you get to #3 and that site can't be crawled, skip it & make it one of the one or two sites we don't insta-crawl.

Your Proposal:

To submit the code, go to the Expensify/App GitHub repo where you'll create a fork of our codebase. You'll create a branch on that fork, and when your code is ready for review, you'll create a pull request in our repository to merge your code into our codebase. Include screenshots and confirmation that you have tested the pull request on all platforms. Our engineers will review the code, and approve and merge when the code meets our requirements.

Please review our Contributor Guidelines before submitting a proposal - github.com/Expensify/App/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

- Merged PR within 6 business days - 0% bonus
- Merged PR within 9 business days - 50% **penalty**

description:
CUSTOMER wishes to use AI to generate summary analysis (reports) of IT vendor contract proposals ("deals").  To generate these reports, we would train an AI model using existing reports created by CUSTOMER analysts on similar deals by the same vendors.
 
For example, CUSTOMER sees dozens of deals every year from the IT vendor, Salesforce.  Currently, CUSTOMER analysts benchmark these Salesforce deals against Salesforce deals we have seen previously.  Given CUSTOMER's expertise with Salesforce, the analyst will then create a multipage report, called a "Fair Market Value" (FMV) report, that provides guidance to the CUSTOMER client on the potential to improve (or "optimize") a given deal.  The FMV report will typically contain a summary overview of our findings, an assessment of whether or not the deal can be optimized, and findings and recommendations specific to the deal in question.  The findings and recommendations might include negotiation strategy, pricing analysis, pricing targets, and concluding remarks.
 
A significant amount of the content for FMV reports are "boiler plate" based upon existing FMV reports on, for example, Salesforce deals.  CUSTOMER assumes that AI (ChatGPT or other) has the potential to generate much of the boiler plate FMV content for a given deal, enabling the CUSTOMER analyst to focus on customizing the generated content, tailoring it to the specific deal and client at hand.
 
CUSTOMER is looking for an AI Consulting Company with experience in AI (ChatGPT or other) to help us prove our assumption during a Proof-of-Concept engagement.
 
During the POC, CUSTOMER would provide the following:
•	The raw text of multiple (100s of) FMV reports for 3 vendors broken out into distinct, normalized sections.  At our discretion, CUSTOMER would disguise the actual names of the clients to maintain the confidentiality agreements that we have with our clients.  The AI consultants will let us know how many documents are needed per each of the 3 vendors to complete the proof of concept.
•	The AI Consultants will have email, video conferencing, chat, phone, and in-person (if needed) access to CUSTOMER's CTO, the GM of CUSTOMER's digital division, selected CUSTOMER analysts and partners.

The AI Consulting Company will
•	Review the provided raw text provided by CUSTOMER and determine what is required in building a model to support our objectives.
•	Build a functional model that demonstrates that our objectives can be achieved.
title: AI Proof of Concept Project with Davinci Model

description:
Press release writer in a business context, it is essential to focus on crafting press releases that support the organization's business objectives. This means being aware of the company's overall strategy and messaging and ensuring that any press release aligns with these goals.

Some key elements to consider when writing business-focused press releases might include:

Understanding the target audience: This includes identifying the media outlets and journalists who are most likely to be interested in the news and tailoring the messaging to resonate with their interests and needs.

Highlighting the business impact: Business-focused press releases should emphasize the tangible benefits or outcomes that the news will bring to the company, whether that's increased revenue, improved customer satisfaction, or other key metrics.

Being strategic with timing: Press releases should be timed strategically to coincide with other marketing or business initiatives, such as product launches, earnings reports, or industry events.

Staying on brand: Business press releases should be consistent with the company's overall brand messaging and tone, to ensure a cohesive and recognizable image to the public.

By focusing on these elements, a business-focused press release writer can help an organization communicate its key messages effectively and generate positive coverage that supports its overall business goals.

description:
Job Overview:
We are looking for a highly skilled developer to create a SaaS Chat Bot powered by OpenAI. The chat bot will have all the features of Tidio.com with the addition of a Training section, which will allow the user to train the AI Database using OpenAI ChatGPT Style Training, URL Parsing/Scraping, and File Upload (CSV). The developer will also architect the Master Database and Customer Specific Database in a way that the data is owned by us, not OpenAI, to increase the value of our company. The chat bot will have an affiliate system, and will accept payment via Stripe and Paypal.

Responsibilities:
* Develop a SaaS Chat Bot powered by OpenAI with all the features of Tidio.com and a Training section
* Architect the Master Database and Customer Specific Database to ensure data ownership by our company
* Implement an affiliate system and payment options via Stripe and Paypal
* Propose the tech stack and reasons for choosing it
* Propose project milestones and timelines for approval
* Provide full end-to-end documentation via Google Documents
* Upload all code to my GitHub
* Provide all deliverables, including Frontend, Chat Bot, Backend, and Affiliate System

Requirements:
* Proficient in OpenAI, Python, and front-end technologies
* Experience in SaaS development
* Strong understanding of databases and data ownership
* Ability to integrate payment gateways and affiliate systems
* Excellent communication skills
* Detail-oriented and able to work under pressure to deliver projects on time
* Available for ongoing support and maintenance for 5 years after project completion

Project Duration:
The project will start on the date of agreement and must be completed within 15 days. The developer will propose project milestones and timelines for approval.

Payment:
Employer will pay the Developer $1500 upon completion. Any delays will result in a $100 penalty per day. The developer will also receive 5% of profits from the Chat Bot generated, paid monthly via Paypal for all future bug fixes and feature improvements.

Deliverables:
The developer will provide Frontend, Chat Bot, Backend, and Affiliate System. Full end-to-end documentation will be provided via Google Documents, and all code will be uploaded to my GitHub. The developer will also provide all features of Tidio.com and everything mentioned in the MVP requirements in the three videos provided.

Tech Stack:
The developer will propose a tech stack and reasons for choosing it. The employer will approve the proposed tech stack before development begins.

Front-End Design:
The employer will provide the Front-end design via Figma file, and Frontend development will be the last step after developing the Chat Bot and Backend. The developer will start with a basic Frontend design featuring a "Get Started For Free" button.

Niche Selection:
The chatbot will have the ability to choose the niche in the registration and settings page, such as dental, health, fitness, parenting, martial arts, travel, fashion, and other options. Once the user selects a niche, the chatbot will be restricted to answering questions only related to that particular niche. The database will be designed accordingly to ensure that the chatbot is not able to answer questions outside of their niche.

If you are an experienced developer with expertise in OpenAI and SaaS development, we encourage you to apply for this position. Please provide your portfolio and relevant experience in your proposal.

description:
I'm looking for a Machine Learning/Deep Learning professional who can build a classification model on online betting data (attached in excel).

One should be experienced with python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning techniques and should be aware of how to apply different custom loss function as per the model results.

Rules of the assignment:
1. Build a ML/DL classification model. I've included an excel file where the target is to predict the next category. There are only 3 categories.
2. The output of the model should include the probabilities for each class as well as the benchmark probabilities used to select the class.
3. Model's performance will be measured in terms of how many consecutive wrong predictions are there. Good model is the model when the output is incorrect not more than twice in a row.
4. Live data will be used to verify model predictions. Therefore, an inferencial script will be necessary.


About the game:

A card is drawn randomly from a well shuffled deck of cards. The drawn card is placed back into the deck, which is then reshuffled, before the following card is drawn..

Cards are divided into three categories- A,B & C. Category A has 6 cards (Ace-6), Category B has 4 cards (7-10) and category C has 3 cards (J,Q,K). Also since there are 4 suits, the number of cards in Category A become 24 cards, category B - 16 cards and category C - 12 cards that makes a total of 52 cards in total.

The objective is to predict which card category will open next.
These prediction can be done in 2 ways
1.  model predicts which category will open next.
2.  the model predicts which category will not open next.
Both the methodologies will have different payout and penality.

Method 1 : 
1. If prediction is A and it's correct then reward is 1 X bet amount else penality is 1 X bet amount
2. If prediction is B and it's correct then reward is 2 X bet amount else penality is 1 X bet amount
3. If prediction is C and it's correct then reward is 3 X bet amount else penality is 1 X bet amount

Method 2:
1. If prediction is not A and it's correct then reward is 1 X bet amount else penality is 1.5 X bet amount
2. If prediction is not B and it's correct then reward is 1 X bet amount else penality is 2.5 X bet amount
3. If prediction is not C and it's correct then reward is 1 X bet amount else penality is 3.5 X bet amount

Average Stats is that Out of 100 drawn, there are nearly 25Cs, 35Bs and 45As. Can we build something that correctly predicts these categories once with high confidence.



Once, the final model is trained and tested, retraining will be required every 2 weeks. You should be ready to do retrain in the same budget.

Let me know if you have any suggestions.
title: Multi Class classification - Machine Learning

description:
I'm looking for a computer vision expert for a challenging and interesting object detection task.

The task is to capture the circular coordinate trajectory of two objects rotating around each other from an aerial view of a camera feed. 

The part that I'm struggling with is correcting for the measurement noise, as well as the slight camera angle perspective shift which slightly distorts the circular motion into an ellipse. 

The object detection is already mostly implemented. But it would be great to get a brief consultation and audit of the existing methods for object detection. Experience with detecting moving objects in dynamic environments is a definite requirement. 

The ideal candidate will:
- Have a strong foundation in physics, geometry, and math
- Have experience in computer vision and object detection with Python OpenCV, bonus points for experience with libraries like Yolo or platforms like Roboflow 
- Have experience with perspective transforms and Kalman filters

The deliverable will be for the Python OpenCV program to be able to accurately determine the relative angle / position between the two objects of interest, as well as the full coordinate trajectory of both objects.
title: Computer Vision Expert for Detecting Fast Moving Objects

description:
Hi everyone,

I sell educational videos that I've originally produced in English. I currently rely on subtitles when catering to non-English speaking customers, which is not ideal. I would like to create non-English versions of my videos using voiceovers produced with AI. I've solved the Text to Speech part of the puzzle, and have the voiceovers ready. The final step is synching the lips of the speakers appearing in the videos with the AI-generated audio. I want my videos to feel natural. I believe this can be accomplished with the existing deep learning technologies.

Your task will be to take the videos with coaches speaking in English and synch the lips of the speakers appearing in the videos to the new audio tracks that I've generated in other languages. 

The videos are mainly (1) speakers talking in front of the white board, and (2) speakers talking into the camera. But they are not just talking heads, which makes it more complex. I try to make my videos as dynamic as possible, so I often change angles, zoom in and out to avoid boring the audience. I understand a static talking head would be easier to lip synch, but my case is a bit more complex. It's still just one person talking at a time, just a bit more dynamic. 

Another complexity is beards. One of my coaches has a bushy beard. Can you work around that?

I am prepared to pay a top hourly rate to an experienced and knowledgeable person, who will get the job done, but I don't want to reinvent the wheel. I want to use existing technology. I might be prepared to invest a little into customizing the existing technology, but won't commit to creating anything from scratch. An off-the-shelf solution would be ideal. Subscription-based SAAS solutions would be fine too.

Please only respond if you know what you're doing. Can you deliver lip synching that will look natural? I don't need videos that contain artifacts and look fake. 

In your response, please explain in detail how you propose to solve this problem and overcome the specific challenges I listed.
title: Voice to Lip Synch for Educational Videos Using AI

Expensify is a team of generalists developing today's leading expense management tool. Maintaining our reputation as an innovative leader in the world of finance requires an incredibly reliable and secure system for processing financial transactions. Accordingly, we primarily leverage time-tested languages, but we're looking to unify our front-end across platforms. For this, we're leveraging React Native and are looking toward the community on Upwork to help solve a variety of problems, both big and small, related to this migration.

Your Proposal:

- You *must* post a proposal for how you will fix this issue in the GitHub issue linked above.
- Your proposal should include a technical explanation of the changes you will make. You are not required to submit the final solution or code along with your proposal.
- Your proposal will be reviewed.

You'll create a branch on that fork, and when your code is ready for review, you'll create a pull request in our repository to merge your code into our codebase. Include screenshots and confirmation that you have tested the pull request on all platforms. Our engineers will review the code, and approve and merge when the code meets our requirements.

Payment timelines are all based on the day the contributor has an accepted proposal and is assigned to the Github issue
